# ANTIMICROBIAL SUSCEPTIBILITIES

Antimicrobial selection should be based on likely susceptibilities of anticipated or proven pathogens. Clinicians should be aware of local, regional, and national susceptibility patterns. Several sources for susceptibility patterns are listed below.

Local PDF File:

[Minneapolis-Antibiogram](https://vhaantimicrobialstewardship.github.io/assets/uploads/001-TestStation/AntibiogramMinneapolis.pdf)

Testing spreadsheet:

[Experimental spreadsheet](https://vhaantimicrobialstewardship.github.io/assets/uploads/001-TestStation/AntimicrobialStewardshipGuidanceCombined.xlsx)
